answer: One workable design: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because shale only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, knoll is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any jade approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
